summary: Diagnose where HPWL changes across global input, legalize, improve placement, and final mirror stages before assigning routes.
use_when: Every Teacher round before selecting routes, especially when legal HPWL and final HPWL disagree.
avoid_when: Never use as the only mechanism; it is evidence selection only.
done_criteria: Teacher names the dominant HPWL-loss stage
Teacher separates final donors from stage donors
Teacher states one falsifiable route outcome

summary: Use the prepared evolved_legalm start branch as a stage-level dense/high-util legalizer prior, only when full-flow score evidence does not already prefer another route.
use_when: Dense/high-util cases show large legalization HPWL inflation and current full-flow score evidence does not show LEGALM damaging final HPWL for that case archetype.
avoid_when: Do not force it when macro/row fragmentation or conflict repair dominates, metrics favor Diamond or negotiation, or very high-utilization dense full-flow evidence says LEGALM is only a diagnostic/HPWL-stage donor.
done_criteria: Student switches to or continues the intended LEGALM seed only with a stated full-flow hypothesis
legalization-stage HPWL inflation is reduced and final HPWL is checked against the strict full flow
source diff changes LEGALM or its handoff instead of only constants
if final HPWL regresses, Teacher labels the result as diagnostic/stage donor rather than promoted parent

summary: Use evolved_diamond or Diamond-family starts for local greedy legalization/detail improvement when local closure is the likely source.
use_when: Baseline Diamond is strong, row conflicts are local, or LEGALM/negotiation adds runtime without stage benefit.
avoid_when: Do not copy classic Diamond as a no-op; add a new objective, candidate generator, or handoff consumer.
done_criteria: Student names the local HPWL source
diff changes local scoring/search or legalizer/improve handoff
result is compared against all canonical baselines

summary: Use evolved_negotiation when conflict resolution, row scarcity, or cut-row-like feasibility pressure dominates legalization.
use_when: Diamond fails or produces large displacement/legality stress while negotiation succeeds or conflict counters explain the gap.
avoid_when: Do not let negotiation dominate so strongly that legalizer/DPO changes become no-ops; require stage counters and source mutation.
done_criteria: Conflict mechanism counters are nonzero
legal placement is produced under stress
Student either improves negotiation internals or builds a handoff consumer

summary: Implement LEGALM/global differential guidance plus detailed refinement as a source-level frontier that can beat pure local greedy when the handoff is correct.
use_when: Legalization stage inflates HPWL, local greedy cannot see global net movement, or a global route has stage signal that needs handoff/improve repair, provided full-flow score evidence does not already reject LEGALM for the case archetype.
avoid_when: Do not approximate with a disconnected greedy interval polish that discards the global guidance signal; do not abandon a stage-strong global route before repairing detailed refinement/handoff.
done_criteria: Legalization uses global/differential score before commit
refined legal solution stays connected to guidance output
handoff state exposes residual or frontier information to improve placement
Teacher preserves LEGALM as a parent only when full-flow HPWL improves, otherwise keeps it as a named stage donor

summary: Use local greedy legalizer improvements as a bounded repair or second-stage hybrid after global or negotiation guidance.
use_when: A global/negotiation route has useful stage signal but leaves local HPWL or displacement defects.
avoid_when: Do not rerun unchanged Diamond endpoints or call repeated random tails; distill the local clue into one bounded source mechanism.
done_criteria: Hybrid sequence is inside the algorithm, not repeated endpoint execution
local repair consumes residual/frontier state
runtime is bounded by candidate caps or caches

summary: Recommended runtime-quality DPO donor using source-edge cached scoring and bounded candidate evaluation.
use_when: Final HPWL needs improve-placement recovery but runtime must stay controlled; use as first DPO donor or mutation base.
avoid_when: Do not treat it as a finished universal optimum; inspect stage metrics and mutate candidate generation/objective if final HPWL plateaus.
done_criteria: DPO donor or mutation runs with nonzero counters
after-improve HPWL improves or failure is attributed to acceptance/objective
runtime stays explainable through cache/cap evidence

summary: Quality-ceiling DPO donor for stronger final HPWL exploration when extra bounded runtime is acceptable.
use_when: A candidate needs a more aggressive improve-placement consumer and prior runtime headroom exists.
avoid_when: Do not promote if it buys quality only by broad rescans or repeated endpoint execution; rewrite for cache/parallelism first.
done_criteria: Quality mechanism changes source-level candidate/objective/acceptance
runtime cost is classified as useful bounded search or fixable implementation cost
Teacher receives enough evidence to choose quality vs runtime frontier

summary: Pass residual high-impact net/cell/row information from legalization into improve placement so DPO preserves or exploits legal-stage gains.
use_when: Legal HPWL improves but after-improve or final HPWL erases the gain; stage donor needs a consumer repair.
avoid_when: Do not add metadata that no later stage consumes; require nonzero producer and consumer counters.
done_criteria: Legalization writes bounded handoff state
improve placement consumes it in candidate ordering/scoring/acceptance
logs prove both producer and consumer ran

summary: Add and inspect lightweight counters/logs to separate algorithm failure, non-execution, stale binary, and runtime bottlenecks.
use_when: Every route with a new mechanism, especially when metrics are weak, runtime changes, or counters may be zero.
avoid_when: Do not log per candidate/per net in hot loops; aggregate stage-local counters only.
done_criteria: Counters prove primary mechanism liveness
runtime bottleneck is classified
zero-counter or stale-binary paths are reported as non-executed

summary: Paper-derived pseudocode index for Tetris/Diamond, Abacus, Jezz, history/network-flow, BonnPlace/Darav, NBLG, LEGALM, double-row, fence-region, parallel legalization, pin-access/Ripple-style legalization, and technology/region/VAC/NIMH constraint-aware legalization. Implementation-ready cards are split under knowledge/algorithm_cards/legalization/.
use_when: Before Teacher assigns a legalizer mechanism or Student writes an algorithm-flow plan.
avoid_when: Do not use as a fallback license; preserve LEGALM/NEGOTIATION/DIAMOND path purity.
done_criteria: Teacher cites a paper mechanism
Student maps it path-purely
logs prove the mechanism ran

summary: Paper-derived pseudocode index for FastDP, OpenROAD DPO taxonomy, GPU-DPO/LSMC, ABCDPlace, density-aware DP, Jezz, Hippocrates, timing-driven DPO, MrDP, handoff-aware DPO, DFM/spacing/implant-aware DP, ECO refinement, and macro/prototype refinement. Implementation-ready cards are split under knowledge/algorithm_cards/dpo_refinement/.
use_when: Before Teacher assigns DPO/handoff work or diagnoses why a legalizer basin is not DPO-recoverable.
avoid_when: Do not apply during legalizer-only iterations unless DPO is explicitly in scope; use it for diagnosis/handoff only.
done_criteria: DPO mechanism has nonzero counters
stage-wise HPWL improves or failure is diagnosed
runtime cost is justified by C_HR

summary: Local ordered-greedy, Abacus/PlaceRow cluster, and Jezz incremental legalization mechanisms for DIAMOND-family local repair and DPO-friendly row-order preservation.
use_when: The design feature looks locally recoverable, Diamond is near-competitive, or the legalizer needs faster row-local repair without cross-path fallback.
avoid_when: Do not use it to hide high-level resource infeasibility or fragmented-row constraints; switch to resource/constraint cards when residual conflicts dominate.
done_criteria: Mechanism counters are nonzero
path remains DIAMOND/local-repair pure unless explicitly translated as an objective
full-flow HPWL validates the row-order change

summary: History-flow, iterative augmentation, max-movement flow, and NBLG-style negotiation mechanisms for scarce-resource and conflict-heavy legalization.
use_when: Row capacity, cut-row-like pressure, mixed-height conflicts, or residual conflict queues dominate legalizer failure or displacement.
avoid_when: Do not call Diamond or LEGALM as hidden closure; implement native resource assignment, conflict pricing, component solving, or infeasible certificates.
done_criteria: Resource/conflict counters prove the mechanism ran
all residual components close legally or report a bounded certificate
runtime remains bounded by sparse graph or component caps

summary: LEGALM/ALM global guidance plus bounded exact adjacent-row or residual-component repair for globally informed legalization.
use_when: Local greedy cannot see global net/resource structure, legal-stage HPWL inflation is large, or LEGALM needs a tighter legal closure tied to its target field.
avoid_when: Do not replace LEGALM output with another legalizer; do not apply broad target shifts that are not connected to legal assignment and DPO recoverability.
done_criteria: Global guidance remains connected to final legal placement
bounded exact repair closes only sized components
full-flow HPWL proves DPO recoverability or marks the result as a stage donor

summary: Fence-region, fragmented-row, pin-access, technology-constraint, and deterministic parallel legalization mechanisms.
use_when: Fixed cells, fence regions, fragmented rows, pin access, technology constraints, or large independent regions dominate the legal resource model.
avoid_when: Do not optimize on a clean-row abstraction when constraints are the real blocker; do not accept per-region parallel wins before deterministic merge validation.
done_criteria: The constraint predicate is shared by candidate generation and validation
parallel work has deterministic boundary repair
full-flow check passes after all constraints

summary: FastDP-style swap/reorder/segment clustering, OpenROAD DPO stage taxonomy, ABCDPlace batching, and density-aware legal candidate scoring.
use_when: DPO needs a stronger HPWL descent kernel, exact-delta cache, deterministic batch commit, or density-aware candidate filter.
avoid_when: Do not parallelize weak candidate generation or attribute legalizer gains to DPO without stage-wise evidence.
done_criteria: DPO counters show attempts and accepted moves
exact HPWL deltas or safe caches guard commits
stage-wise metrics show after-improve gain

summary: Jezz legality oracle, do-no-harm filters, timing/quadratic target refinement, and MrDP-style multi-row DPO windows.
use_when: Single-row DPO is stuck, legality dry-run cost is high, or multi-row/mixed-height neighborhoods likely contain the HPWL source.
avoid_when: Do not add timing or do-no-harm filters to an HPWL-only run unless they are used as bounded candidate sources or safeguards.
done_criteria: Legality remains true after every accepted move
multi-row windows are bounded by stress markers
runtime is explained by accepted gain or pruned candidates

summary: Handoff-aware DPO, LSMC-style basin escape, and runtime-controlled large search using compact producer/consumer counters.
use_when: Legal-stage donors lose their gain after improve placement, DPO local minima block HPWL progress, or runtime headroom should be spent on deeper bounded search.
avoid_when: Do not produce handoff metadata that no consumer reads; do not increase restart count when accepted basin changes are rare.
done_criteria: Producer and consumer counters are both nonzero
large-step or handoff moves improve exact HPWL
runtime cost is justified by accepted gain rate

summary: Rule-aware DFM/spacing/implant filters, ECO incremental refinement, and bounded macro/prototype refinement windows.
use_when: Placement improvement is localized around rule-risk regions, changed regions, macro edges, or prototype-stress windows.
avoid_when: Do not turn refinement into global placement from scratch; do not let rule penalties suppress the HPWL objective without evidence.
done_criteria: Refinement windows are bounded and legal
boundary repair succeeds
rule-aware filters act as safeguards or tie-breaks unless explicitly targeted
